signIn.noPassword: No password needed. We email you a 6-digit code the first time you sign in on a phone or computer.
signIn.joiningHint: Joining your family? Open the invite link they sent you.

errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or send a new one.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

welcome.title: You're signed in
welcome.noHomeYet: You're not part of a home yet.
welcome.joinHint: If your family already uses HomeFood, open the invite link they sent you instead.
welcome.comingNext: Home setup is the next build step.

setup.title: Almost ready
setup.body: HomeFood isn't connected to its database yet. Add the Supabase Project URL and anon key to a file called .env.local, then restart the app.

step1.title: Set up your home
step1.subtitle: You're the Admin. You can change all of this later.
step1.whoLivesHereHint: Add everyone who eats at home. Only people who want to vote, comment or plan need a login.
step1.addPersonHint: For each person: name and birth year. Sex, activity level and allergies are optional and used only for nutrition tips and allergy warnings.

errors.homeName: Enter a home name (up to 60 characters).

form.name: Name
form.allergiesPlaceholder: Type an allergy and press Enter

invite.title: Invite your family
invite.subtitle: Send one link to the family group. Each person taps it and picks their name.
invite.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — long-press the link to copy it.
invite.qrHint: Family members scan this with their phone camera
invite.footer: Works only for {{home}} · expires in {{days}} days · you can cancel it anytime
invite.noLoginFootnote_one: {{names}} doesn't need a login. You can plan and record meals for them.
invite.noLoginFootnote_other: {{names}} don't need a login. You can plan and record meals for them.

steps.poster: Open the Week at a glance poster

join.notListed: Not listed? Ask {{name}} to add you first.
join.notListedFallback: Not listed? Ask whoever invited you to add you first.
join.privacyNotice: Only {{home}}'s members see what you share here. We store your email for sign-in and nothing from social media.
join.emailHint: We'll email you a 6-digit code. No password.
join.nameTaken: That name was just taken. Pick another, or ask the Admin to add you.
join.expired: This invite link has expired or was cancelled.
join.askForNew: Ask whoever invited you for a new link.
join.noOneToJoin: No one else here has app access yet. Ask your Admin to turn on "Uses the app" for someone in People, then share this link again.
join.alreadyInHome: You already belong to a home.

install.title: Install HomeFood
install.body: Add it to your home screen for quick access, like any other app.
install.iosBody: Add it to your home screen: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".

planner.title: Plan the week
planner.nothingToCopy: Nothing to copy from last time.
planner.cooksLabel: Who cooks · pick one or more
planner.addHelperHint: Have a helper who cooks? Add them from the Home tab — pick "Helper" when adding a person, no login needed.
planner.eatingSummary: Recipe scaled to {{count}} · helper not counted
planner.notePlaceholder: e.g. Less spicy for the kids

allergy.headline: Contains {{list}} — affects {{names}}
allergy.body: Marked as eating this meal. Cook a separate portion, pick another dish, or keep it and note it for the cook — check ingredients either way.

planner.outHint: No cooks needed. This meal still goes into your history.

outsideSize.label: How big was it?
outsideSize.hint: Optional. A rough size is added to My and Family nutrition as an estimate.
outsideSize.about: Counted as about {{kcal}} kcal each (a rough estimate).

rota.title: Planner rota
rota.subtitle: Who plans the meals · {{month}}
rota.explain: Anyone can take a turn for a day, a week or a month. For now, your Admin assigns turns — self-service turns are coming later.
rota.askAdmin: Ask your Admin for a turn

today.nothingNextUp: Nothing planned yet — tap to plan it

attendance.title: Did you eat this?
attendance.saveFailed: Couldn't save that. Please try again.
attendance.nutritionNote: Skipped meals and meals eaten elsewhere are left out; small and large portions count as 75% and 125%.

glance.title: Week at a glance
glance.shareUnavailable: Sharing isn't available on this device — try Save as image instead.
glance.dishesOnly: Dishes only · no names or health details

dishes.empty: No dishes match. Try clearing a filter, or add one.
dishes.dietMarkHint: Diet mark: green = veg, brown = egg, red = non-veg
dishes.cuisineHint: Only your home sees this cuisine. You can pick it when adding a dish.

detail.allergensSafe: No one in {{home}} has these allergies.

form.tagsPlaceholder: e.g. fried, vegetable, spicy — press Enter
form.nutritionHint: An estimate you type in yourself. It is always shown as an estimate. Leave it empty if you are not sure.

nutrition.problem: Calories, protein, carbs and fat are needed, as plain numbers (for example 450 or 12.5).

form.photoHint: Add a photo now, or later from the dish page.

dishes.noFavourites: No favourites yet. Tap the heart on a dish to add it.

home.needsInvite: {{name}} can now use the app — share the invite link below so they can join.
home.historyHint: See what your home has eaten, by week, month or year
home.weekStartHint: Meals you already planned stay exactly where they are.

discussion.noComments: No comments yet. Be the first.
discussion.somethingElsePlaceholder: e.g. something light, no fried food
discussion.nothingPlanned: Nothing is planned for this meal yet.

recipe.title: {{dish}} recipe
recipe.none: There is no recipe for this dish yet. Try the YouTube link on its page.
recipe.cookModeHint: Keeps the screen on and makes text bigger
recipe.checkIngredients: A drafted recipe: check the ingredients, allergens and seasoning before you cook.

nutrition.kcalOfDay: kcal · about {{percent}}% of an adult's day
nutrition.barsNote: Bars show share of an adult's daily need. Estimates for planning, not medical advice.

note.softChew: Soft and easy to chew: good for {{names}}.
note.spicyKids: Spicy: go easy for {{names}}, or serve it with curd.
note.friedCare: Fried: keep the portion small for {{names}}.
note.sweetInfo: A sweet treat: enjoy it in small portions.
note.gheeRich: Ghee-rich. Use a spoon less, or pair it with a vegetable side.

nutrition.mineSub: The meals you ate, against your daily target
nutrition.familyOnly: Family nutrition is for Admins and whoever is Planner today.
nutrition.unavailable: Nutrition numbers are not available yet.
nutrition.assumed: We assumed {{what}}. Add it under Home › People for a closer target.

assume.sex: an average of female and male

nutrition.empty: No meals with a nutrition estimate in this period. Plan meals and mark yourself as eating them.
nutrition.emptyPerson: No meals with an estimate in this period.

tip.proteinLow: Protein looked low on {{n}} of {{days}} days. Dal, eggs, curd or paneer can help.
tip.sodiumHigh: Salt was high on {{n}} of {{days}} days. Go easy on pickles, papad and packaged foods.
tip.fibreLow: Fibre is at {{percent}}% of the target. More vegetables, dal and whole grains help.
tip.caloriesHigh: Calories are about {{percent}}% of the target. Smaller portions of fried or sweet dishes can help.
tip.caloriesLow: Calories are only {{percent}}% of the target. Check that every meal is planned, or add a snack.
tip.sugarHigh: Sugar is about {{percent}}% of the limit. Sweets and sweet drinks add up.

nutrition.unknownMeals: {{count}} meals had no estimate (dine-out, order-in, or a dish without numbers), so they are left out.
nutrition.disclaimer: Nutrition figures are estimates for planning at home, based on typical recipes and portions and rounded reference values. They are general guidance, not medical advice.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: What changed in your home's meal plan
notifications.empty: Nothing new yet. You will see here when a week is published, a meal changes, someone comments or suggests a dish, or you are set as a cook.

text.cook_assigned: {{actor}} set you as a cook for {{day}} {{meal}} ({{what}}).
text.suggestion_declined: Your suggestion {{suggested}} for {{day}} {{meal}} wasn't taken this time.

history.title: Meal history
history.subtitle: What your home has eaten
history.empty: No meals were planned in this period.
history.eatenOf: {{eaten}} of {{total}} meals were eaten (from what people marked on {{recorded}} of them)
history.noRecords: Nobody has marked what they ate yet, so every planned meal counts as eaten. You can mark it under each meal below.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

theme.hint: Applies to this phone or computer only.

demo.exploreHint: Try the app with a made-up family. No sign-up, and nothing is saved.

roleHint.admin: Admin (Amma): plans any day, manages people and the home's settings.
roleHint.planner: Planner (Appa): plans the days of their turn. Everything else is view, vote and comment.
roleHint.member: Member (Kavi): votes, comments and suggests dishes. The Planner decides.

demo.unavailable: This is not available in the demo.

data.kaviSpicy: Could we make it a little less spicy tonight?
data.ammaSure: Sure, I will go easy on the chilli.
data.kaviBiryani: Can we have extra raita with it?

tips.label: Tip
tips.title: Tips and welcome tour
tips.showAgainHint: Brings back the short tips on each screen. This phone or computer only.
tips.showAgainDone: Done. Each tip will show again the next time you open its screen.
tips.today: Tap a meal to open it. Agree or disagree right on the card, and say what you actually ate.
tips.week: Tap a day, then a meal, to plan it. Planners can copy last week and publish when it is ready.
tips.slotEditor: Pick a main dish, up to 3 sides and who cooks. Allergy warnings follow who is eating this meal.
tips.dishes: Tap the heart on a dish to make it a favourite. Favourites and dishes you plan often come first.
tips.dishDetail: Tap the photo to see it large. The buttons below open the recipe, YouTube and Instagram.
tips.glance: Save this poster as an image, or share it to your family's WhatsApp group.
tips.discussion: Agree, disagree, comment or suggest another dish. The Planner has the final say.
tips.home: People, invites, settings, history and nutrition all live here.

balance.title: A gentle heads-up for this week
balance.eatingOut: {{count}} meals in a row are dine-out or order-in.

limit.sameMain: Same main dish, this many times or more
limit.fried: Meals with a fried dish, more than
limit.outRun: Dine-out or order-in meals in a row, this many or more

balance.settingsHint: The Week tab shows the Planner and Admin a gentle note when a week goes past these. It is only a suggestion; the Planner decides. Usual numbers: {{same}}, {{fried}} and {{run}}.

cookAgain.title: Cook {{dish}} again
cookAgain.hintPlanner: Pick a free {{meal}} in the next 14 days. A meal that is already planned is never replaced.
cookAgain.hintMember: Only the Planner can add a meal to an empty slot. You can suggest {{dish}} for a {{meal}} that is already planned, and the Planner decides.
cookAgain.freeNotYours: Free · not your turn to plan
cookAgain.plannedDone: Planned: {{day}}, {{meal}}. Open it to add sides and cooks.
cookAgain.suggestedDone: Suggested: {{day}}, {{meal}}. The Planner will see it.
cookAgain.taken: That meal was planned in the meantime. Pick another.

recipeEdit.title: Edit our version
recipeEdit.intro: This becomes your family's own copy. The standard recipe stays as it is, and you can go back to it at any time.
recipeEdit.introOwn: This is your family's version of the recipe.
recipeEdit.problemQuantity: Add an amount, for example 2, 1.5 or 1/2.
recipeEdit.problemStep: Add the text of this step.
recipeEdit.problemNone: Add at least one ingredient and one step.
recipeEdit.problemMinutes: Minutes must be a whole number up to 600.
recipeEdit.backHint: Removes your family's version. The standard recipe shows again.
recipeEdit.onlyAdmin: Only an Admin can edit the family's recipes.

outsideNutrition.note: A dine-out or order-in meal is counted only if you said how big it was (light, normal or heavy), as a rough estimate.

cuisines.hint: These are the cuisines your home added. The shared cuisines cannot be changed.
cuisines.inUse: It cannot be deleted while dishes use it. Change or remove its {{count}} dishes first.

extras.title: My extras today
extras.empty: Nothing logged yet. A banana, an egg, tea, nuts: add what you eat outside the family meals.
extras.total: Extras so far: {{kcal}} kcal · {{protein}} g protein
extras.privateMine: Only you can see these items.
extras.privateAdmin: You keep these for {{name}}. As Admin, only you can see them.
extras.noResults: Nothing found. Try "Something else…" to add it yourself.
extras.yesterdayAlready: Everything from yesterday is already logged today.
extras.customHint: A food that is not in the list. Calories and protein are optional: copy them from the packet label if you have it.
extras.customProblem: Use plain numbers, for example 120 or 4.5.
extras.previewUnknown: No calories entered for this food, so it is not added up.
extras.estimateNote: Estimates for planning at home, not medical advice.
extras.familyNote: Includes personal extras: only each person's daily totals are shown here, never what they ate.

goals.title: My goals
goals.hint: Optional. If you set a number it is used on your Today and My nutrition screens instead of the suggested value. Only you can see it.
goals.hintAdmin: Optional. Only you, as Admin, can see goals you keep for people without a login.
goals.problem: Protein: 10 to 400 g. Calories: 800 to 6000. Whole numbers only.

protein.title: Protein today
protein.mealsAndExtras: Meals and extras together. An estimate, not medical advice.

account.title: Your data and account
account.downloadHint: Everything about you and your home's meal plans, as one file.
account.signOutAllHint: Ends every session of your login, on every phone and computer.
account.signOutAllBody: You will be signed out here and on every other phone or computer, and asked for a new code the next time you sign in.
account.deleteAccountBody: This cannot be undone. You will be signed out and your login will stop working.
account.removed: Removed: your login, allergies, goals, usuals, extras, votes, attendance, suggestions and notifications.
account.kept: Kept: your home's meal plans and comments. Your name on them becomes "Former member".
account.lastAdmin: You are the only Admin. Give the Admin role to someone else first (Home tab, People), or delete the household instead.
account.deleteHomeBody: This removes the whole home for everyone: its people, plans, dishes, recipes, history, photos and every login that belongs to it. It cannot be undone.
account.typeName: Type the home's name to confirm: {{name}}
account.nameMismatch: The name does not match. Type it exactly as shown.

tour.title: Welcome tour
tour.replayHint: The four short cards you see when you first open HomeFood.

plan.title: Plan the whole week in minutes
plan.body: Breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner for your family.

say.title: Everyone gets a say
say.body: Agree, comment or suggest a dish.

glance.title: Your week at a glance
glance.body: A colourful menu poster to share with the family.

safe.title: Eat well together
safe.body: Nutrition tips and allergy warnings for every member.

shopping.title: Shopping
shopping.regularsNone: No regulars waiting. Open an item and tap “Regular” to find it here next time.
shopping.placeholder: Type an item, e.g. tomato 1 kg
shopping.empty: Nothing on the list yet. Type an item above.
shopping.loadError: The shopping list could not be loaded. Please try again.
shopping.unavailable: The shopping list is not available yet.
shopping.shareNote: Sends items and amounts only · everyone in {{home}} sees this list
shopping.clearBody: This removes every item for everyone in {{home}}. Regular items stay available under Regulars.
shopping.browseHint: Tap to add the usual amount; change it on the list. Items your home saves show “Our item”; rename or remove them under Home › Our common items.
shopping.newSaveHint: Next time it shows up when you type or browse.
shopping.oursHint: Items your home saved for the shopping list. Everyone in the home sees them; the person who saved one, or an Admin, can rename or remove it.
shopping.oursEmpty: Nothing saved yet. Add a new item on the shopping list and keep “Save to our common items” switched on.
shopping.oursRemoveAsk: Remove {{name}} from our common items? It stays on the shopping list if it is there.
